CustomField.description: Get the latest date of a stage change
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISBLANK(Date_30__c), ISBLANK(Date_35__c), ISBLANK(Date_50__c), ISBLANK(Date_60__c), ISBLANK(Date_80__c), ISBLANK(Date_90__c), ISBLANK(Date_95__c), ISBLANK(Date_100__c) ), NULL, DATE(1900, 01, 01) + MAX( BLANKVALUE( Date_30__c, DATE(1900, 01, 01) ) - DATE(1900, 01, 01), BLANKVALUE( Date_35__c, DATE(1900, 01, 01) ) - DATE(1900, 01, 01), BLANKVALUE( Date_50__c, DATE(1900, 01, 01) ) - DATE(1900, 01, 01), BLANKVALUE( Date_60__c, DATE(1900, 01, 01) ) - DATE(1900, 01, 01), BLANKVALUE( Date_80__c, DATE(1900, 01, 01) ) - DATE(1900, 01, 01), BLANKVALUE( Date_90__c, DATE(1900, 01, 01) ) - DATE(1900, 01, 01), BLANKVALUE( Date_95__c, DATE(1900, 01, 01) ) - DATE(1900, 01, 01), BLANKVALUE( Date_100__c, DATE(1900, 01, 01) ) - DATE(1900, 01, 01) ) )
CustomField.label: Last Stage Change
